en.headline: More than half of Po Pin Chau bookings unused on National Day
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said about 1,160 people arrived on Thursday against roughly 2,420 bookings, and released slots on the day.
body: More than half of the people who booked the Po Pin Chau section of the High Island Geo Trail did not turn up on National Day, even though the day had been fully reserved, the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said.

Wen Wei Po, citing the department, reported that about 2,420 people had booked for Thursday and about 1,160 arrived through the day, a figure that includes visitors who took slots released on the spot. The South China Morning Post separately reported more than 1,200 no-shows. Staff watched entry numbers and freed unused places for immediate booking, and the department said identity checks were generally completed within a few minutes.

A new photo spot on the East Dam section helped spread visitors, the department said. Bookings for the Po Pin Chau section remain full from 1 to 6 October. The department has been reminding travellers at boundary crossings, in Sai Kung and on mainland social media that the real-name system is in force and that some days are already full. Live crowd figures for the East Dam are posted on the hiking crowd page.

About 2,020 people also visited Sharp Island on Thursday, the department said. Officers increased coastal patrols, used drones over popular snorkelling spots, and reminded visitors to stay on the coral-friendly route and not to feed or collect marine life.

zh.headline: 國慶日破邊洲逾半預約未到 漁護署即場放額
zh.dek: 漁護署表示，周四約有2420人預約破邊洲段，實際到訪約1160人，包括即場放額後補上的遊人。
body: 西貢萬宜地質步道破邊洲段國慶日預約額滿，但逾半預約人士沒有出現。漁農自然護理署表示，當日約有2420人預約，全日實際到訪約1160人，當中包括署方因應入場情況即時釋放名額後補上的遊人。
文匯報引述署方報道上述數字。南華早報則報道爽約逾1200人。署方稱人員全程監察入場，並按情況釋放名額供即時預約；核證一般數分鐘內完成，秩序大致良好。東壩段新設的打卡點亦有助分散人流。
十月一日至六日的破邊洲段預約仍然全日額滿。署方已在口岸、西貢市、北潭涌閘口及內地社交平台提醒旅客預約制已經實施，部分日子沒有餘額。東壩一帶的實時人流，可在遠足人流資訊網頁查閱。
同日約有2020人到訪橋咀洲。署方加派人員在岸邊及熱門浮潛點巡查，並以無人機監察，提醒遊人走珊瑚友善路線，不要餵飼或採集海洋生物。
